title: Teller letter commending John Alexander

tellings.quote: there's a letter where Teller is like commending John Alexander saying like, you know, this guy has made all these important updates in non-lethal warfare.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there is a letter from Edward Teller, the physicist behind the American hydrogen bomb, praising a man named John Alexander. According to Michels, Teller writes that Alexander made important advances in non-lethal warfare, meaning weapons built to stop people without killing them. Michels raises it to show that a leading weapons scientist vouched for Alexander's work.
